notes.title: Version 1.4.0 Now Available!
notes.notes: [p]Plenty of stylish new gear and adorable furniture have been added, giving you even more ways to customize your look and decorate your home.[/p][p]Customize your avatar and house with everything you love, and express your own unique style! ✨[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495104/dfc1946ae45393d9c311c3eb055050075fa23101.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: An update is coming mid-June!　See Even Further Across the Field 👓
notes.notes: [p]See Even Further Across the Field 👓[/p][p]An update is coming mid-June![/p][p]You asked, we listened. We’re adding a camera adjustment feature that lets you see much farther across the map than before.[/p][p]Spot towers easily while exploring or track down that monster you’re after.[/p][p]Enjoy a smoother, more exploration-friendly Fantasy Life![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495104/b1ebad47e2934a4b6cfd518e23b60968fb3cb72d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495104/4c3ed743b4a0a4b16cb0ca2b57b70aa4103bf493.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: FANTASY LIFE i: The Girl Who Steals Time is set to release on Wed, May 21st !
notes.notes:
FANTASY LIFE i: The Girl Who Steals Time is set to release on Wed, May 21st (GMT) for Nintendo Switch, PS5/PS4, Xbox Series X|S & Steam!
Check the new trailer showcasing all the things you can do in this Slow-Life RPG, such as the new Treasure Groves.
